description.en:
Adds a character to the party with no message and no jingle, then sets their flags. It is what every AddParty_* and AddPartyNum_* helper calls for each character.
It calls CMND_ADD_PARTY; if that returns a handle greater than 0, it passes the flags to CMND_SET_PT_LOCK_FLAG, CMND_SET_AVATAR_ENABLE and CMND_SET_AVATAR_LOCK_FLAG, and sets the level with CMND_SET_LV when _lv is greater than 0. If CMND_ADD_PARTY returns 0 or less, nothing else happens.
Parameter ID of the character to add, e.g. "para_cp0015".
Passed to CMND_SET_PT_LOCK_FLAG for the new member. Every shipped call passes true.
Passed to CMND_SET_AVATAR_ENABLE (whether the member's Fighting Spirit is enabled). Most shipped calls pass false; a few later events pass true for para_cp0009 and para_cp0010.
Passed to CMND_SET_AVATAR_LOCK_FLAG for the new member.
Level to give the member with CMND_SET_LV. Only used when greater than 0.
